scope: Open the Motif Paint editor in an owned Xephyr, make a test pixel edit, exercise undo/redo/save/close/reopen, and correct isolated fallback text visibility.

runtime.title: PARA LSI — I458 Paint editor | Xephyr :86

changes.motif_text: The Paint dialog inherits the Theme Lab Motif font list; if unavailable, it retains an X core-font fallback. Compound strings use the same locale multibyte path as the main Theme Lab view.
changes.native_palette_fallback: Without a KDE palette in the isolated profile, role samples are read from the current Motif form, content, and canvas resources (foreground, face, view, highlight, top shadow, bottom shadow). No final color literals were added.
changes.theme_generation: Manual raster remains separate from native toolkit recipes and generated code.
